item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las gtum mo mkha' spyod zab lam myur 'grub snying gi thig le
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa 'bod pa bdag la grogs kyi dang po mkhas btsun rnam dag 'od zer gyi skyes mtha' rje drung mu wer zhi'i (zhis) rten 'brel bskul rkyen rang 'grigs dang*/ ma mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bskul te gnas mchog zla ba shel lung du bskyod nas shing stag zla 12 ba'i tshes 24 la brag dkar rin chen spungs pa'i bca' sti'i 'og nas grwa slob dbang po'i grangs dang bcas dngos grub du rnyed cing / shing yos zla 1 tshes ” la mi dang mi min mkha' 'gro'i ('gros) grogs byas nas lo chen bI ro'am paN Ti ta yi 'khyud yig la bod yig tu zhe zhol gsang khrod du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
